children: Launch Two filed a registration statement on Form S-4 related to its proposed business combination with NuCube.
Launch Two and NuCube publicly filed a Form S-4 registration statement with the SEC on Sept 11, 2026.
The S-4 includes a preliminary proxy statement/prospectus for Launch Two shareholders to vote on the merger.
Closing remains subject to shareholder approvals and customary closing conditions for the announced June 25 business combination.
Securities cannot be sold until the registration statement is declared effective by the SEC; no offer or solicitation now.
Proxy materials and related documents will be available on the SEC website once the registration statement is effective.
